decisions.statement: Two characters a story draws together into one are two characters.
The earlier of the two states this, and the one drawn together with states nothing.
A page stating this keeps the claims read before the drawing together.
The character drawn together with is the one the story follows afterwards.
A character offered this and refusing it states nothing here.
A character stating this is not another name for the character named.

definition: the character another character was drawn together with
